book.title: The Richest Man in Babylon
book.description: This personal finance, worldwide, best-selling classic has been modernized so that you can take advantage of these rich-thinking principles in easy to read modern English. The original, "King James" dialogue was likely easy to read 90 years ago, but in modern times, has become difficult for generation X and younger. Learn the secrets of wealth the top 1% know that you don't because you were never taught financial education in school. Learn to keep and multiply your money so that you will prosper and your money will work as hard as you do.
